notes.title: How to start the game in VR mode
notes.content: We see that many players do not know how to start the game in VR mode. Specially sent a notice to answer it. This is because the game supports both PC and VR mode. The specific method is shown below.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33423636/bf1aa16b4ef61408d9ffcd81cb55a33c6daa5062.png[/img]

notes.title: Crazy alchemist has released,you can be a great alchemist.
notes.content:
Crazy alchemist has released, open the game, enter the fantasy world. 
Today you are a great alchemist. Go and refine your artifact！
You are welcome to comment and join the community discussion game. If you like this game, be sure to recommend it to your friends.

notes.title: We are working hard to develop it
notes.content: I'm sorry, we failed to release it as scheduled. We are working hard to develop it. All the questions are for everyone to have a better experience. Please be patient.

notes.title: Send me e-mail if you want to join to test
notes.content: Please send me an email so that I can send key to you. My e-mail address: customerservice@5thvr.com. The next test is about to start.

notes.title: Crazy Alchemist should be released at the end of the month.
notes.content: I'm sorry, Crazy Alchemist has not been released on time. Because we have added more content, we want to bring a better game experience to you. Just a moment, please. It should be released at the end of the month.
